name: smwmusic-touhou-eiyashou-imperishable-night-nightmares-of-the-past-nostalgic-blood-of-the-east-old-world-remix
title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Nightmares Of The Past ~ Nostalgic Blood of the East ~ Old World (Remix)
description:
𝓘 𝓬𝓪𝓷'𝓽 𝓱𝓪𝓷𝓭 𝓸𝓿𝓮𝓻 𝓽𝓱𝓮 𝓱𝓾𝓶𝓪𝓷𝓼 𝓽𝓸 𝔂𝓸𝓾 𝔂𝓸𝓾𝓴𝓪𝓲.
𝓘'𝓵𝓵 𝓶𝓪𝓴𝓮 𝓼𝓾𝓻𝓮 𝓽𝓱𝓲𝓼 𝓷𝓲𝓰𝓱𝓽 𝓷𝓮𝓿𝓮𝓻 𝓱𝓪𝓹𝓹𝓮𝓷𝓮𝓭!

Did an arrangement of Keine Kamishirasawa's theme Nostalgic Blood of the East ~ Old World from Touhou 8: Imperishable Night. Probably the one Touhou theme I associate the most with SMW romhacking. It was one of the first Touhou songs I ever heard and fell in love with (alongside Keine's boss theme, Plain Asia). It's easily one of my favorite songs in the series for nostalgia alone, and it sucks that it's also one of the most criminally underrated theme in the series because it's so damn good!!! It's easily one of ZUN's best works, if you ask me.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor w/ Slight Detune (Remix Pitch - Listening-Only)
2. B Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
3. C# Minor (Original Pitch)
4. D Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
2. Disables Voice Clip (turned on default)
